model: T-033 bake-off C3 (multilingual MiniLM intent+slot encoder, int8)
extracted_from: the C3 training run's meta.json (external to this repo)
note: Logit-index order of the compiled encoder's intent and slot heads, committed so the Swift runtime (IntentEncoderManifest.t033Spike) can be checked against the training run without the external meta.json. Logit-order misalignment silently maps a correct index to the wrong label/action, so this file is the in-repo reference for that order. The label set is the LEGACY LLM-format snapshot (10 intents, contact/time tags only), NOT the T-034 schema-v2 BIO label set.
